attempts.summary: Repaired and applied the SQLite v1→v2 migration on node1. The migration is transactional and repeatable, preserves IDs/descriptions, initializes price_cents to 0, enforces nonnegative values, and updates schema_version only within the successful transaction. RHEL 10.0, the installed kernel, packages, services, permissions, and security controls were preserved. Restart persistence and recovery were verified.
